items.titleJa: Claude Code の cross-session messaging で、1 つの文書を複数のセッションと並列に編集する
items.summaryJa: 複数セッションで同じ文書を並列編集する方法を紹介しており、衝突を避けるために cross-session messaging を活用します。各セッションは担当論点を人間と議論して承認された修正を反映させ、決定事項は他セッションへ通知します。セッション間の通信はソケット経由で行われ、送受信は 1 行の短いメッセージに限定して行い、承認行為は人間が行います。同じファイルの同時編集による「意味的衝突」を防ぐには、分岐したセッションへ約束事を共有し、決まった内容を cross-session messaging で伝達する仕組みです。

items.title: AI Gateway logs now show session affinity
items.summary: AI Gateway logs now have a Sessions view that groups requests into sessions and shows how session affinity routed each one. Each row shows the coding agent or app that ran the session, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, along with its cost, models, providers, and how much of its input was cached across every turn. Open a session to see its cache hit rate, duration, and path. The path lists each turn with its model and timing, and names the provider serving the session along with any earlier ones. Session affinity sends each turn to the provider that served the one before it, so the provider already has most of the prompt in cache. A session that stays on one provider reads more of each prompt from cache . Filter sessions by turns, client, model, provider, authentication, or cost. Single-turn sessions are hidden until you clear the minimum turns filter. Session affinity runs by default on text and chat requests. To group requests yourself, send the same sessionId in providerOptions.gateway , or the same x-session-id header, on every request in a conversation. Requests without one are grouped by a fingerprint of the conversation's opening and appear as fingerprinted sessions. Read the session affinity documentation for more information on how AI Gateway identifies sessions. Read more

The visual reasoning model accepts images and video to follow objects through motion, interpret spatial relationships, and connect an action to its physical consequences. Glimpse can return to visual evidence as it works: zooming into a detail, revisiting a short interval of video, or tracking the same feature across frames. items.title: Reflection AI's Beam now available on AI Gateway for free
items.summary: Beam from Reflection AI , previously available in stealth as stealth/cat-jam , is now available on AI Gateway . Beam is free to use for a limited time during the launch period when serviced by Reflection AI. Beam is an low latency US open-weight reasoning model for coding and agentic tasks, with weights released under Apache 2.0 . Beam supports tool calling and structured outputs , with a 1M-token context window for code, documents, and conversation history. Reasoning effort is adjustable. Beam is designed for speed, activating only 23B of its 501B parameters per token and avoiding tokens a task doesn't need, so it tends to reach answers sooner than larger open models. There are 2 ways to access Beam for free: Using the standard model name ( reflection/beam with provider reflection ). When the free period ends, the model slug will automatically transfer over to pricing with no downtime. Using the -free suffix to the standard name ( reflection/beam-free ). The model will stop serving when the free offer ends.
